senses.definition: (√ of foll.; NH Hiph.; Aramaic Aph. אוֹרִיק grow green; ܝܺܪܶܩ be pale, and deriv.; Assyrian arâḳu, grow pale (of face), arḳu, yellow, green, etc., DlHWB 243; Arabic وَرَقٌ leaf, وَرَقَ put forth leaves, cf. وُرْقَةٌ ash-colour, أَوْرَقُ dusky-white, of camel, وَرِقٌ silver coin LagBN 30; Sab. ורק gold (כתם וורק), HalÉS, JAs.
